Black Moon Lilith Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Black Moon Lilith because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+26B8, which you can use as ⚸ in HTML, \26B8 in CSS, or type with Alt+9912 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Black Moon Lilith is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+26B8 is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Black Moon Lilith has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ⚸ or the hex escape ⚸.

How to type black moon lilith on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 9 9 1 2 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 9912.
  4. Release Alt. The Black Moon Lilith character (⚸) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type black moon lilith on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Black Moon Lilith. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Black Moon Lilith" and click the character to insert it.

How to use black moon lilith in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\26B8"; ()
  • Python: \u26B8 or chr(0x26B8)
  • JavaScript: \u26B8 or String.fromCodePoint(0x26B8)
  • JSON: "\u26B8"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ⚸?

No legacy Alt code exists for Black Moon Lilith because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+26B8 in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ⚸ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ⚸, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+9912 not work?

Alt+9912 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Black Moon Lilith?

The Unicode codepoint for Black Moon Lilith is U+26B8. You can use this value in HTML as ⚸, in CSS as \26B8, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ⚸ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+26B8, then click it.
